title: The Owner reads and works a draft in a clean editor: a plain white inbox with no avatars, the actions in one bar under the subject, and the message as readable text
description: The Owner looked at the drafts inbox (FW-C-066) on flowweb.app and called it trash. The list pane and the message sit on a sand (sunken) background, the selected row is a raised white card with a coloured initials avatar, every row repeats that avatar, the viewer header carries a big avatar too, and Copy, Edit, Approve and Reject trail under a long letter in a beige box. Rebuild it as a clean editor. The inbox is plain white with one hairline between the list and the editor; list rows carry no avatar or thumbnail, and the selected row is a light tint with a thin accent bar, no card and no shadow. The editor pane leads with who it is for, the subject as its heading, when it was drafted and its state, then one action bar named Draft actions holding Copy, Edit, Approve (when the flow allows it) and Reject, or Save and Cancel while editing. The message reads as plain text on white at a comfortable line length, not in a box. The AI assistant (FW-C-076) and After you send it stay below the message as quiet sections. Every existing behaviour stays: the drafts-inbox and draft-assistant probes still pass. Nothing is sent.
acceptance: No initials avatar or thumbnail appears in the drafts list or the editor header
The editor has a toolbar named Draft actions with Copy, Edit, Approve and Reject for a ready draft, placed before the message
While editing, the toolbar holds Save and Cancel
The inbox, its list, the selected row and the message body use no sand surface (surface-sunken, surface-page, surface-soft) and the selected row has no card shadow
pnpm probe flows/drafts-inbox and pnpm probe flows/draft-assistant still pass
